BMETT is McMaster University’s first external biomedical engineering team. We design devices, run technical workshops, and compete in biomedical engineering competitions.

Our projects ↗Meet BMETT ↓

About BMETT

We’re a student team working on biomedical device design at McMaster University.

Members contribute through research, software, electrical and mechanical design, and team operations. Our activities include the True North Biomedical Competition, workshops, and conferences.

Instagram ↗

Device design

Research, build, and test biomedical prototypes for the True North Biomedical Competition.

Technical workshops

Workshops cover CAD, embedded systems, and 3D printing.

Conferences

Members attend and present at events including CUBEC and BioTEC.

TrACL

Our knee rehabilitation prototype measures muscle activity and range of motion to help inform ACL rehabilitation decisions.

Muscle activity

Wet electrodes measure muscle activity to explore what’s happening during rehabilitation.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to be in iBioMed?+

BMETT brings together students from different disciplines. The November 9 workshop explicitly welcomes all faculties. Contact the team about eligibility for a future member intake.

Do I need prior technical experience?+

The 3D printing workshop is beginner friendly and requires no experience. Requirements for team positions are set out during recruitment.

How can I join the team?+

Fall 2026 general member and 2026–27 lead applications are closed. Follow @mcmasterbmett and check the official links for future openings.

How can I get in touch?+

Send BMETT a message on Instagram for general questions, partnerships, or event information. You can also follow the team on LinkedIn.
